assertions.name: reading_a_is_near_miss_not_exact
assertions.source: Reading-A's -G coefficient differs from implied c_2 by between 1e-30 (anything above is 'not exact') and 1e-3 (anything below is 'near miss'). Numerically: |c_implied + G| ≈ 3.16e-4.

description: mp.mpf 50-dps audit of the ACTUAL implied h² coefficient of linking_weight at q_0 (assuming h²-only truncation). Finds c_implied ≈ −0.91628, distinct from Reading-A's −G (off by 3.2e-4) and −11/12 (off by 3.8e-4). The Reading-A 5.6 ppm m_p match is a near-miss, not a structural identity.

if_c2_is_minus_G.interpretation: If Reading-A's c₂ = -G is exact, then h⁴+ corrections must total ≈ -1.38e-5 at q_0. PR #1272's via_jones h⁴+ tower at q_0 totals ≈ -5.86e-3 (OPPOSITE SIGN, 420× larger) — different normalization, NOT a candidate for the actual h⁴+ correction.

data.conclusion: Reading-A (h²-only with c₂ = -G) is a NEAR-MISS to target_lw at 50 dps. The implied actual h² coefficient is -0.91628, differing from -G by 3.2e-4 and from -11/12 by 3.8e-4. Neither is the exact structural constant. Path C work needs to identify either (a) the new constant -0.91628..., (b) the h⁴+ tower that closes the residual to zero exactly, or (c) a correction to Vol(𝓑₃) beyond 8·G (literature says 8·G exact, so this is unlikely).
